item.title: [Backport release-26.05] gpac: add patches for CVE-2026-103227, CVE-2026-108538, CVE-2026-124030, CVE-2026-124031, CVE-2026-128239 and CVE-2026-128240
item.description:
Manual backport of #590836 to release-26.05, since the automatic backport failed.

The cherry-pick conflicted because release-26.05 does not have #577803 ("gpac: use cacert bundle instead of vendored CA bundle"), so that commit is backported first.

gpac-unstable on release-26.05 is at 26.07.0-unstable-2026-08-04, which predates all six fixes, so the two version bumps from master (#518151, #590225) are backported as well. 26.07.0-unstable-2026-11-18 contains all fixes.

With this, pkgs/by-name/gp/gpac/package.nix is identical to master.

Tested: nix-build -A gpac -A gpac-unstable on x86_64-linux (release-26.05), MP4Box -version.

This PR was prepared with AI assistance (Claude Code); I reviewed the changes.
item.dc:creator: thesn10

item.title: cryptomator: 1.19.6 -> 1.19.7
item.description:
1.19.7 only disables the JVM's Base64 intrinsics (-XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics) to remove the attack surface for CVE-2026-114938. The packaged JDK is the Zulu 27 JavaFX build, which is not part of the November security release (only the plain Linux JDKs were updated for that CVE), so carry the flag in the wrapper to match upstream.
